guitar.guitaristsText: Jonny Greenwood / Ed O'Brien / Thom Yorke
guitar.evidence: Jonny Greenwood's Telecaster Plus and Ed O'Brien's Stratocasters/Jazzmasters are well documented among Radiohead gear-heads.

tone.target: jangly clean arpeggios into biting fuzzed-out crunch with wah color
tone.profile: jangly clean arpeggios into biting fuzzed-out crunch with wah color
tone.summary: A bright, articulate chain starting with a Chorus and Comp for the arpeggios, followed by a powerful Fuzz or Distortion section, incorporating Wah sweeps throughout.

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise during quiet arpeggio sections.
Enhance the initial bright clean arpeggios and sustain.
Achieve the 'Rickenbacker-style chime' and bright arpeggio texture.
blocks.gap: The GP-180 lacks a dedicated clean boost/preamp, so Chorus helps add sparkle.

blocks.purpose: Provide the required wah sweeps for dynamic color and expression.
Deliver the biting fuzzed-out crunch for the second section.
Simulate the bright, articulate clean/crunch tone (Fender/Vox influence).
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe is chosen for its classic Fender voicing, fitting the 'Strat/Tele' clue.

blocks.purpose: Provide a bright, focused cabinet sound suitable for arpeggios and crunch.
Add subtle depth and space without muddying the jangly arpeggios.
Keep the delay subtle as requested by corrections.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR for increased clarity and bite, especially when transitioning from clean arpeggios to fuzzed crunch.

proposals.reason: Enhance chime and bite for arpeggios, preventing muddiness in the fuzz section.
